BiblicalUsage: Ophni was a town of Benjamin, named in the allotment of the tribe's cities, standing among the hill towns north of Jerusalem. It was one of the twelve cities allotted to Benjamin in the hill country.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the smallest named towns matter: God allotted every town by name, and no corner of His people's land was forgotten.
